basics.name: Austin Henry
basics.label: Infrastructure & Integration Engineer
basics.summary: I run the infrastructure and automation layer for a 2,000-person, nationally distributed company — Terraform-managed AWS behind a public mobile app, GitLab CI pipelines, P1 on-call, and an identity-provisioning platform that turned per-app access grants into API-driven provisioning on hire. Twelve years of customer-facing technical work means I'm comfortable owning a problem from a stakeholder's whiteboard to a running system.

work.name: Dutch Bros Coffee
work.summary: Platform, identity and automation engineering for a nationally distributed retail brand — and the day-to-day admin for its SaaS portfolio (Okta, Jamf Pro, Zendesk, marketing platforms) and vendor renewals.
highlights: Maintain the Terraform estate (**5–15 stacks**, multi-environment) and the GitLab CI pipelines for the AWS infrastructure behind the public Dutch Bros mobile app, in partnership with Cloud Ops. TODO: environment count, deploy cadence, one concrete win with a number.
Own application monitoring and alerting and take the on-call rotation for **P1** incidents across the application estate. TODO: services covered, incident volume or MTTR.

Designed and built the Workato provisioning layer across HRIS, Okta, Google Workspace, Jamf Pro, Slack and Zendesk — manual per-app access grants became provisioning on hire and deprovisioning on exit for a **2,000+** person organization. TODO: hires per year, time-to-access before → after.

Built custom Workato connectors against the Emplifi and Yext Management APIs where no vendor connector existed; automated the Yext user lifecycle for a **90,000**-potential-user field organization and eliminated **2 hrs/week** of manual vendor work.
Configure Okta SCIM provisioning and SAML/OAuth application integrations; own license assignment and reclamation across the SaaS catalog. TODO: integrated app count, licenses or dollars reclaimed.
Lead automation projects for internal customers end to end — scoping with HR, Security and Operations, solution architecture, delivery, and the runbooks that keep them running.

Build AI agents and MCP servers inside Workato and use Claude Code with MCP integrations daily; script against the Jamf Pro and Zendesk APIs in Python and Bash and manage the macOS fleet in Jamf Pro. TODO: fleet size.
